name: Guard
description: Shield Guard (Vanguard): +6 defense per turn.

name: Guard II
description: Shield Guard rank 2 (Vanguard): +8 defense per turn.

name: Guard III
description: Shield Guard rank 3 (Vanguard): +10 defense per turn.

name: Taunt
description: Shield Guard (Vanguard): +40 aggro per turn.

name: Rally
description: Rally (Vanguard): +4 attack per turn, applied to the whole party.

name: Rally II
description: Rally rank 2 (Vanguard): +6 attack per turn, applied to the whole party.

name: Rally III
description: Rally rank 3 (Vanguard): +8 attack per turn, applied to the whole party.

name: Poison Coat
description: Poison Coat (Rogue): no effect by itself each turn — while active, every damaging hit the bearer lands also applies "Poisoned" to whoever got hit.

name: Poison Coat II
description: Poison Coat rank 2 (Rogue): +4 attack per turn, on top of the same on-hit Poisoned rider.

name: Poison Coat III
description: Poison Coat rank 3 (Rogue): +6 attack per turn, on top of the same on-hit Poisoned rider.

name: Poisoned
description: Poison Coat/Poison Bomb (Rogue): lose 4 HP per turn.

name: Poisoned II
description: Poison Bomb rank 2 (Rogue): lose 6 HP per turn. Exclusive to Poison Bomb — every other poison source stays plain Poisoned.

name: Poisoned III
description: Poison Bomb rank 3 (Rogue): lose 8 HP per turn. Exclusive to Poison Bomb — every other poison source stays plain Poisoned.

name: Burning
description: Fireball/Fire Pillar (Mage): lose 5 HP per turn. Not curable via mini-game (deliberate — distinguishes it from Poisoned).

name: Weakened
description: Crush (Skeleton Guard - Boss): lowers the target's defense for a few turns.

name: Stunned
description: Lightning Bolt/Lightning Storm (Mage): skips the turn entirely while active. Not curable via mini-game.

name: Empower
description: +6 attack per turn.

name: Fortify
description: +8 defense per turn.

name: Distracted
description: -20 aggro per turn.

name: Regeneration
description: heal 10 HP per turn.

name: Poison Vulnerable
description: While active, doubles the per-turn damage of the bearer's own Poisoned tick.

name: Corroded
description: Acid Spit (Slime): lose 3 HP and 4 defense per turn.

name: Webbed
description: Web Spit (Spider): lose 20 speed per turn.

name: Storm-Empowered
description: Lightning Axe (Viking): every landed hit also splashes lightning damage across all enemies.

name: Storm-Empowered II
description: Lightning Axe rank 2 (Viking): every landed hit also splashes stronger lightning damage across all enemies.

name: Storm-Empowered III
description: Lightning Axe rank 3 (Viking): every landed hit also splashes the strongest lightning damage across all enemies.

name: Bleeding
description: Frenzied Slash/Spinning Axe (Viking): lose 5 HP per turn.

name: Blinded
description: Blinding Vial (Plague Doctor): the bearer's own attacks/skills miss 60% more often for the duration.
